1.consolidated_definition: Nombre del guineo maduro usual en barrios del interior central y oriental de la Isla. Por el territorio interior que desciende hacia el litoral oriental, se oye el nombre, tal vez afronegroide, de forrongo para el guineo maduro.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Name of the mature guineo fruit commonly found in central and eastern interior neighborhoods of the Island. In the interior territory that descends towards the eastern coastline, one hears the name, possibly of African origin, forrongo for the mature guineo fruit.
